title: Unit Killing Initial Data
summary: We find a system of differential equations on an initial data surface whose solutions are in bijection with unit vector fields on the Einstein $Λ$-vacuum development that are proportional to a Killing vector. We refer to these conditions as the \textit{unit Killing initial data} (uKID) equations, analogous to the classical \textit{Killing initial data} (KID) equations. The uKID equations can be useful in a setting where only the unit-normalized part of the Killing vector is geometrically distinguished.
